articles.summary: arXiv:2609.25413v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Third-party evaluations for frontier AI have mostly tested models through external interfaces before deployment. articles.title: Incipit: Axiom-Grounded Scaffolding for Human-AI Literary Creation
articles.summary: arXiv:2609.25504v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models can produce fluent prose from short prompts, but a direct interaction gives writers little access to the assumptions that shape a long narrative. We present Incipit, an implemented research prototype that inserts an explicit planning layer between writer intent and generated prose. articles.title: Instructional Governance by Design: A Framework for AI in Computing Education
articles.summary: arXiv:2609.26098v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As generative AI permeates computing instruction, the emergent design challenge is to configure each tool's pedagogical role, authority, and accountability for the instructional work it performs. articles.summary: arXiv:2609.26139v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Competitive programming courses often inherit the visible features of programming contests -- timed rounds, rankings, penalty systems, and topic lists -- before articulating what novices should learn.
